title: Check Binary Search Tree
prompt:
Given the root of a binary tree (TreeNode objects), decide whether it is a valid binary search tree. In a valid BST, for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater. An empty tree is valid.

Note: comparing each node only with its direct children is not enough.

Example:
      5
     / \
    3   8
       / \
      4   9
  is_bst(root) -> False   (4 sits in the right subtree of 5 but is smaller than 5)
